name: Konstantinos Arvanitis - § 168 - Am 11
title: REPORT on the Commission’s 2025 Rule of Law report
part_text: 168. Believes that EU-level interinstitutional dialogue and cooperation on the rule of law should be strengthened by subjecting the EU institutions themselves to the same rule of law and anti-corruption scrutiny and accountability mechanisms applied to Member States, in order to ensure internal coherence and the credibility of the rule of law framework;
